# Draft:Princess Jin Yunxian of Qing Dynasty

Princess Jin Yunxian (1914 - 2003),was a Princess of Qing Dynasty, She was the fourth daughter of Zaifeng, the Prince of Chun and eldest daughter her mother Lady Denggiya, who was one of Prince Zaifeng's concubines.
Early Life
In 1914,Princess Jin Yunxian was born in the Forbidden City  to the fourth daughter of her father Zaifeng, the Prince of Chun and the first daughter of her mother was Lady Denggiya, who was one of Prince Zaifeng's concubines..
She already had 3 sisters and two brothers at the time of her birth and her eldest brother, Puyi, was the deposed Emperor of China.
Death and Burial
In 2003 Princess Jin Yunxian passed away at the age of eighty-nine and second - longest living among the seven sisters
